note: Photo-object pairs left out of the site (2026-11-18, owner: many photos show another object). Rules applied to the Commons title, address and distance (tools: see sources.md): (1) the title names a house number that is not the object's -> dropped; (2) the title names a street, a view, a panorama or a detail -> dropped; (3) one file near several objects and nothing ties it to this one (no house number in the title, not clearly the nearest) -> dropped; (4) the remaining single photos without a building word in the title were looked through one by one and street scenes, views, interiors of shops, Mapillary 360 frames, signs and the like were dropped. Kept: house number matches the address; a building word in the title; the nearest object; looked through and fitting. Pairs approved earlier by hand (photos_far_approved.json) are not touched.
